messages:
lina_support: FYI - AcmeRetail opened an escalation. Their embeddings endpoint is returning different vector lengths depending on which deployment handles the request (hosted vs dedicated). Seen after they shifted ~30% traffic to Dedicated.
ops_bot: <ticket created: #INC-2026-443> Assigned to support oncall.
arjun_eng: Can you paste a minimal repro? Is it deterministic or intermittent?

lina_support: Repro steps from customer (they provided curl):

```bash
# Hosted (api.redwood.ai)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_acme' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","input":"hello world"}'

# Response (hosted):
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.001, ...],"embedding_length":1536}],"model":"text-embedding-3-large"}

# Dedicated (dedicated-acme.redwood.internal)
curl -s -X POST https://dedicated-acme.internal/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_ded_acme' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","input":"hello world"}'

# Response (dedicated):
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.002, ...],"embedding_length":768}],"model":"text-embedding-3-small"}
```

lina_support: Note the dedicated response shows model="text-embedding-3-small" even though request specified text-embedding-3-large. Customer claims they always pass model param explicitly.

maria_ml: That smells like alias routing / fallback. If the dedicated environment has a different alias map, a missing large model binary could cause a fallback to the small model. Can you confirm the model id the router forwarded?

arjun_eng: Request routing logs (sanitized) from the customer's dedicated ingress: 

```
[2026-03-10T14:12:03Z] req_id=abc123 tenant=acme model_requested=text-embedding-3-large resolved_model=text-embedding-3-small route=dedicated-pool-2 reason=model_not_found
[2026-03-10T14:12:03Z] req_id=abc123 response_status=200 embedding_len=768
```

arjun_eng: Looks like the router couldn't find the large model artifact in that pool and silently routed to the small variant. That's a bug: we should not fall back across size families without an explicit policy.

noah_sre: I see autoscaler spun up a new instance with a trimmed image (quantized-only) at 14:10. Dedicated pool had a fast startup that didn't include the large model. Possible race where autoscale image selection omitted the model artifact. I'll check the dedicated pool image tags and startup logs.

zara_customer_success: Customer is seeing embedding mismatch in their semantic search results. They ask for mitigation and whether this impacts billing/SLAs.

lina_support: Customer also saw throughput change and some increased latency during the window. They attached a sample of batched requests where the library sends 8 sentences at once. They suspect batching triggers different routing.

arjun_eng: Batching could push requests to a different node due to sizing constraints. Can you reproduce with a local dedicated-like pool? Try batch of 8 vs 1 and capture resolved_model header.

lina_support: I repro'd in our staging dedicated pool. With batch_size=1 I get large (1536). With batch_size=8 I sometimes get small (768). Example request we used: 

```json
{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","input":["a","b","c","d","e","f","g","h"],"batching":{"max_batch_size":8}}
```
and the node that handled it had log: resolved_model=text-embedding-3-small because available memory was low -> fallback to smaller variant.

maria_ml: Two issues: 1) fallback across model families is dangerous (dim mismatch). 2) the client shouldn't be billed for a model that differs from the one requested. We'll need to check billing attribution.

noah_sre: I've pulled container startup logs - a recent change to the dedicated pool's provisioning script pruned unused model artifacts to speed spin-up. The pruning criteria were too aggressive and removed the large model from some hosts. Autoscaler then routed batches to nodes without the large model.

arjun_eng: Proposed immediate mitigations:
- Hotfix router to enforce model family mismatch -> return 5xx or explicit error instead of silent fallback.
- Add an explicit header X-Resolved-Model in responses to make it visible to clients.
- For customer-facing mitigation, pin the model to a Dedicated pool that we verify has the artifact (we can set a placement constraint).

lina_support: Customer asked for a short-term rollback or credit. CS asked to hold credits until we confirm blast radius.

zara_customer_success: I'll prepare a statement: apologize, give a 7-day usage credit hypothesis until eng confirms scope.

maria_ml: For long-term: ensure alias resolution table is consistent across Hosted/Dedicated/Private by distributing model catalog via central registry + version lock. Also add an eval test that ensures embedding shape matches expected dims per model id.

arjun_eng: Action items (brief):
- noah_sre: revert pruning change and add verification step (ETA 2h).
- eng-runtime (me): push router patch to return 409 or 503 on unresolved model_family mismatch (ETA 3h).
- billing: validate invoices for Acme for the window and mark any misattributed charges for review (zara).
- support: send mitigation instructions to customer (lina/zara).

noah_sre: Started rollback of pruning in dedicated-pool-2, pulling model artifact now. Progress log: "fetching model text-embedding-3-large -> 40%"

lina_support: Sending customer interim note: "We're investigating. Temporary mitigation: pin your requests to a specific deployment or set header X-Redwood-Model to avoid aliasing. We'll update in ~4h."

arjun_eng: Follow-up: let's add an automated smoke test post-rollback that sends 10 batched requests and asserts embedding_length==1536 for text-embedding-3-large. If any mismatch, fail the node health check.

maria_ml: Also include a regression test that checks billing attribution doesn't change when fallback happens (shouldn't charge for a different family).

zara_customer_success: Thanks everyone. I'll coordinate customer comms and the credit ask.

ops_bot: <INC-2026-443> status updated: investigating -> patching.

lina_support: I'll update thread after the rollback completes or if we see anomalies. :thumbsup:
